== Summary ==
A player with an earlier Team Tournament Winner medal (Minnesota outline), posted the night before the [[2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament]] by forum user Valorc: "Wow my backing is going to really be hurting on Sunday from carrying my team to victory this Saturday." The player is not yet identified.

* '''Event:''' [[2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2018-04-07
